AI.TITLE: Artificial intelligence
AI.PROGRAMMANAGERBIO:
Dr. Sherif Mostafa Hashad is a Lecturer at the Faculty of Computers and Artificial Intelligence, Beni-Suef University, Egypt, with over 20 years of technical experience in digital transformation and more than 10 years of academic experience in teaching and curriculum development. He holds a Ph.D. in Information Systems from Menoufia University, with research focused on adaptive frameworks for Arabic text classification using advanced machine learning techniques.
Dr. Hashad has a strong background in software engineering, software testing, and project management, having worked with organizations such as the Egyptian Council of State and KHABEER Software Industries. He currently serves as program coordinator, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Beni Suef National University. Also, he served as the Vice Manager of the University Electronic Portal, contributing to digital transformation initiatives and system development.
His research interests include artificial intelligence, natural language processing, and Arabic text classification. He has published multiple papers in international journals and conferences, reflecting his commitment to academic research and continuous professional development.

Also contributed to public sector digital transformation initiatives as a Software Engineer at the Central Agency for Organization and Administration. An active peer reviewer for prestigious international journals like IEEE Access, he is dedicated to advancing smart healthcare technologies. Overall, his career reflects a strong commitment to academic excellence, innovative research, and institutional development.

26.NAME: Dr. Mahmoud Abdel-Wahed
26.DESCRIPTION: Associate Professor of Petroleum and Mining Program Director at Faculty of Science, Beni Suef National University
26.BIO:
Dr. Mahmoud S. M. Abdel Wahed earned his PhD in Environmental Technology from the LUT School of Engineering Science, Lappeenranta University of Technology (LUT), Finland in 2015. His doctoral research focused on the geochemistry and water quality of Lake Qarun, Egypt. With extensive teaching experience, he has instructed undergraduate and post-graduate courses in geology, hydrology, and environmental geochemistry.

Dr. Abdel Wahed has held visiting researcher and collaborative roles at numerous international institutions including Centre National de Recherche en Sciences des Matériaux (Tunis), Aarhus University (Denmark), University of Eastern Finland, United Arab Emirates University, Masdar Institute, and King Fahd University for Petroleum and Minerals (Saudi Arabia).

He has published numerous articles in peer-reviewed, high-impact international journals and supervises Master's and PhD students at Beni-Suef University. After returning to Egypt, he served as a consultant for the Fayoum Wastewater Expansion Programme, funded by the European Union and international banks, contributing his expertise to address Lake Qarun pollution.

As an active science communicator, Dr. Abdel Wahed has published public articles on unconventional water resources in Egypt's water scarcity context and plans to deliver public lectures on sustainable water management, funded by Beni-Suef University.

His research interests encompass hydrology, water quality, environmental impacts of human activities, and aquatic ecosystem protection. He has conducted field studies on major rivers worldwide, including the Nile (Egypt), Yangtze (China), and Teesta and Brahmaputra Rivers in the Indian Himalayas, and contributed to wastewater treatment and purification technology research.

This professional profile illustrates Dr. Abdel Wahed's multifaceted experience as an educator, researcher, consultant, and science advocate with strong international ties and impactful contributions to water resource management and environmental hydrogeochemistry.

27.NAME: Dr. Nabil Hasona
27.DESCRIPTION: Professor of Biochemistry- Microbiology program at BSNU
27.BIO: Prof. Dr. Nabil A. Hasona is working as a coordinator of Biochemistry- Microbiology program at BSNU and Professor of Biochemistry at Faculty of Science, Beni-Suef University , Egypt. He is involved in multidisciplinary research to decipher real life problems from the environment to human diseases. Prof. Nabil’s main research area includes biochemistry, enzymology, biomolecules, molecular biology, human diseases as well as microbiological and biotechnological approaches in these areas. 31.NAME: Dr. Rasha Adel Lotfy
31.DESCRIPTION: Professor of Radio and Television and Political Communication at Beni Suef University, and the Dean of the Arts, Humanities, and Social Sciences Sector at Beni Suef National University.
31.BIO:

Dr. Rasha is a graduate of the "Women Lead" Program (First Cohort) at the National Training Academy, a Certified International Trainer (ToT), and a member of the Arab Union for the Protection of Intellectual Property Rights. She is also an accredited trainer with the Ministries of Youth and Sports and Social Solidarity through the "Mawadda" Project, and serves as a member of the Media Sector Committee at the Supreme Council of Universities and the Political Participation Committee at the National Council for Women.

GLOBAL_EDUCATION_FORUM.TITLE: Beni-Suef National University President Opens the Second International Conference of the Egyptian Climate Group
GLOBAL_EDUCATION_FORUM.SUBTITLE: Climate Change and Sustainable Development
GLOBAL_EDUCATION_FORUM.SNIPPET: Media Center: Dr. Tariq Ali, President of Beni-Suef Ahlia University, opened the Second International Conference of the Egyptian Climate Group.
GLOBAL_EDUCATION_FORUM.DETAIL: Media Center: Dr. Tariq Ali, President of Beni-Suef Ahlia University, opened the Second International Conference of the Egyptian Climate Group titled “Climate Change and Sustainable Development” at Beni-Suef Ahlia University today. The conference, held April 4-5, is a partnership between Beni-Suef Ahlia and public universities under the supervision of Dr. Abu Al-Hassan Abdel-Mawgoud, Vice President for Community Service and conference rapporteur; Dr. Enas Yahya, Vice President for International Relations; Dr. Mohamed Zaki Al-Sudeimi, President of the Egyptian Geographical Society; Dr. Mohamed Ibrahim Sharaf, Conference President; and Dr. Mohamed Fawzi Ahmed Atta, Professor of Physical Geography at the Faculty of Arts, Beni-Suef University. The opening session was attended by Dr. Abdel Aziz Abdel Latif, Professor of Climatological Geography; Dr. Masad Salama Mandour, Conference Secretary; Dr. Rasha Mohamed Tawfiq, Vice President for Academic Affairs; Dr. Hanan Suleiman, Vice President for Employment and Innovation; Dr. Shehata Sayed Ahmed, Conference Group Secretary; Dr. Ahmed El-Gendy, Dean of Health Sciences; Dr. Rasha Adel, Dean of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences; Dr. Ahmed El-Tahami, Dean of the Engineering Sector; and Mr. Mohamed Selim, University Secretary-General. Dr. Mohamed Zaki Al-Sudeimi said the Egyptian Geographical Society is one of the oldest scientific institutions in the Middle East, founded in 1875 by Khedive Ismail to promote geographic knowledge, map study, and environmental research. The society has supported geographic research, documented natural and human change, and preserved the history of Egypt and Africa with tens of thousands of books, journals, and rare maps. It publishes a peer-reviewed scientific journal in both Arabic and foreign languages, hosts international conferences and seminars, and serves as a cultural and academic beacon. Dr. Abdel Aziz Abdel Latif of Ain Shams University said the conference aims to formulate an integrated scientific vision through essential themes covering climate change and its relationship to food and water security, the use of spatial technologies to monitor changes, the impact of climate on the environment and natural systems, the economic and social dimensions, heritage and antiquities, sustainable development under a changing climate, climate action policies, response efforts, and the religious and legislative frameworks that support resilience and sustainable development goals. Dr. Abu Al-Hassan Abdel-Mawgoud underlined the need to use this scientific event to strengthen partnerships between the university and research entities. He stressed the importance of producing actionable recommendations that help decision-makers address environmental crises and praised the university’s role as a scientific beacon aligned with Egypt Vision 2030. Dr. Enas Yahya said the conference vision centers on enhancing the role of geography and atmospheric sciences in understanding development challenges and delivering innovative, practical solutions. She added that the conference aims to deepen scientific communication and build a strong network of specialists locally and internationally. Dr. Shehata Sayed affirmed that climate studies have documented evidence of change since the late nineteenth century, resulting in alterations to the Earth’s solar energy budget and serious environmental impacts on human activity and development. The conference will issue recommendations to guide sustainable development and improve quality of life. The opening session concluded with a shield exchange between the President of Beni-Suef Ahlia University, the President of the Egyptian Geographical Society, and the President of the Egyptian-Chinese University. Honorees included Dr. Abu Al-Hassan Abdel-Mawgoud; Dr. Rasha Tawfiq, Academic Deputy; Dr. Enas Yahya; Dr. Hanan Suleiman; Dr. Abdel Aziz Abdel Latif, Professor of Climatological Geography at Ain Shams University; Dr. Youssef Abdel-Meguid, Professor of Climatological Geography at Cairo University; the late Dr. Abdelaziz Sharaf, Professor of Climatological Geography at Alexandria University; Dr. Mayada Abed Al-Qader, Vice President of the Egyptian Chinese University; Dr. Ahmed El-Gendy, Dean of Health Sciences; Dr. Rasha Adel, Dean of Humanities and Social Sciences; and Dr. Ahmed El-Tahami, Dean of Engineering.
